pages.title: Inspect a Player
pages.text: For operators, /drug <target> get lists active profiles. Add an effect ID after get to inspect just one. Tab-complete names, including the historical cocaine ID, psychedelicraft:coccaine.

pages.title: Controlled Tests
pages.text: Use /drug <target> set <effect> <value> to set a strength, add to adjust it, and lock <effect> <true|false> to hold or release the profile. Use /vomit or /vomit <target> in a test world.

pages.title: Apparition Tests
pages.text: Use /hallucinate <type> [targets] [position]. Tab completion lists the types. The result is local to the affected viewer. A console needs an explicit player target.
